verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code product and its HCP Terraform platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows an assistant inside Terraform that users can delegate tasks to. The Terraform MCP server only gives external AI models access to registry docs and workspaces. That is a developer building block for outside agents, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
